description: Fetch the status or completed result of a survey job (omit job_id to fetch the latest 3-hourly public demo survey). This result is a response simulation by synthetic personas. It is not a survey of real people and does not represent public opinion. (Latest public 3h demo slot: 2026-11-12T00:00+09:00)

api_key.description: api_key.secret that owns the job (or send Authorization: Bearer). Required with job_id.

format.description: brief is compact and meant for AI agents.

job_id.description: Job ID (job_...) from cloneai_synthetic_persona_survey. Omit for the latest public demo.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for completion before returning.

name: cloneai_get_survey_result
title: Get CloneAI Survey Result or Latest 3h Public Demo
